leadText: Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys (Japanese: ポケットモンスター金・銀 ゴールデン・ボーイズ Pokémon Gold and Silver Golden Boys) is a Pokémon manga created by Muneo Saitō. It is based on the plot of the games. It roughly follows the plot of the games up to Cianwood City, and abruptly ends with very little resolution. The main characters are , , and . All three volumes of the series were translated by Chuang Yi.

Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys (Japanese: ポケットモンスター金・銀 ゴールデン・ボーイズ Pokémon Gold and Silver Golden Boys) is a Pokémon manga created by Muneo Saitō. It is based on the plot of the games. It roughly follows the plot of the games up to Cianwood City, and abruptly ends with very little resolution. The main characters are , , and . All three volumes of the series were translated by Chuang Yi.

==International versions==
In and , the manga has been translated to Traditional Chinese as and by Ching-win Publishing, respectively. In , it has been translated to Simplified Chinese as by Jilin Publishing. In , the manga was published by Daewon C.I., titled .

==Trivia==
In the English translation by Chuang Yi, many characters are still known only by their Japanese names, such as DJ Mary (DJ Kurumi) and Buena (Aoi).
